mechanism: Infliximab's immunosuppressive effects via TNF-α inhibition may reduce the efficacy or alter the colonization dynamics of live probiotic organisms, and probiotics may theoretically increase infection risk in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor patients receiving infliximab who use probiotics; prefer non-viable or well-established probiotic strains; counsel on infection signs and consider timing separation if clinically feasible.
